A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Sith apprentice''' served [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Sith Apprentice assisted Vivicar in the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] campaign to destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with the Dark Plague. The apprentice was defeated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order]].
